name: motionvideo-mcp
description: MotionVideo MCP app: search the motionvideo.xyz catalog of AI-made motion videos, pull the original prompts behind them, and browse motion tools and studios.
author: MotionVideo

scripts.plugin:validate: claude plugin validate ./plugins/motionvideo && claude plugin validate .
scripts.plugin:zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/motionvideo-openai-plugin.zip dist/motionvideo-claude-plugin.zip && cd plugins/motionvideo && zip -qr ../../dist/motionvideo-openai-plugin.zip plugin.json mcp.json skills assets README.md -x '**/.DS_Store' && zip -qr ../../dist/motionvideo-claude-plugin.zip .claude-plugin .mcp.json plugin.json mcp.json skills assets README.md -x '**/.DS_Store'
